title: Expresar proporcionalidad y reparto: 'en proporción a' y 'con arreglo a'

sections.content: Article 68.2 of the Constitution specifies that the electoral district ('la circunscripción electoral') for the Congress and Senate is the province ('la provincia'), while Ceuta and Melilla elect one deputy and two senators each. Seats in the Congress are allocated in proportion to the votes obtained ('en proporción a los votos obtenidos') using the D'Hondt formula ('con arreglo a la ley D'Hondt') and closed, blocked lists ('listas cerradas y bloqueadas').

items.spanish: Los escaños del Congreso se reparten en proporción a los votos obtenidos en cada provincia.
items.english: Seats in Congress are distributed in proportion to the votes obtained in each province.

items.spanish: La elección se verifica en cada circunscripción atendiendo a criterios de representación proporcional.
items.english: The election is carried out in each constituency following criteria of proportional representation.

items.spanish: La Junta Electoral Central vela por la transparencia del escrutinio con arreglo a la ley.
items.english: The Central Electoral Board watches over the transparency of the count in accordance with the law.

sections.content: Remember for the CCSE exam: for general elections, the electoral constituency ('la circunscripción electoral') is the PROVINCE (except in European elections, where the constituency is the entire national territory).
